title: Request for proposal for broker notices and service measurement
not_questions: Test notices may go only to the broker council's rehearsal accounts.
Include support charges in a separate schedule.

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Explain how Marketo Engage would reconcile a broker's Salesforce territory change before sending a regional frost warning.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Describe a Marketo Engage suppression rule for a broker who has left an agency but remains on the renewal distribution list.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Set out how a Marketo Engage reviewer would approve the English notice and its French version when one translation arrives late.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Provide the Marketo Engage evidence retained when a required policy notice is delivered and the linked loss form is unavailable.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Describe a Customer Journey Analytics comparison of notice readership between brokers serving one county and brokers serving multiple counties.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Explain how Customer Journey Analytics would reconcile a Snowflake policy extract to the reporting month when a renewal is backdated.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Identify the Customer Journey Analytics checks you would run when a mail security scanner opens every broker notice.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Show the Customer Journey Analytics figures the broker council should review before approving a wider rollout.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Identify the bilingual delivery staff on your proposed team and their availability for a rehearsal in April.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: Provide a customer reference for seasonal insurance communications sent through an independent broker network.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: Describe how your company would transfer responsibilities if the lead consultant left during renewal season.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: State the payment milestones you propose for rehearsal, rollout and the support handover.
